mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines relative to its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% relative to the previous month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand weakness, triggering reduced corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals supply chain disruptions and reduced manufacturing output, lowering corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below its 6-month moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate increase above 2.5% signals rising inflation expectations, prompting Federal Reserve tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) relative to its 12-month moving average signals labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS rises relative to its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI inflation above 2.0% signals monetary policy response to inflation, triggering short-term market correction and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime defined by high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), Federal Reserve tightening causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
